name: Baiona (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, blue above and below and red at the hoist and the fly.
history: The municipal flag of Baiona is composed of four triangles, the upper and lower blue and the hoist and fly red; the oldest known arms are those in the chapel of Santa Liberata, built in 1695, and on one of the doors of the archive built in 1769.

features.role: division per saltire, blue above and below
